title: No perfect cuboid
statement: There are no positive integers a,b,c,u,v,w,d satisfying a²+b²=u², a²+c²=v², b²+c²=w², and a²+b²+c²=d².

counterexample.description: Positive integers satisfying the three face-diagonal square equations and the body-diagonal square equation. Four exact square checks verify a witness.
